subject: Subprocessor provenance heatmap + evidence timetable
messages:
From: Amanda Torres <amanda@acme-labs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-labs.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: provenance heatmap + evidence timetable for third-party roster

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this call earlier. As part of Acme Labs' quarterly vendor vetting we need a concise provenance heatmap for Redwood's subprocessor ecosystem and a delivery timetable for the supporting evidence (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ answers, KMS/residency details). Procurement would like the timeline by Aug 10 so our internal review can close by Aug 18.

Specifically we need:
- A CSV manifest of active subprocessors (role, data access, residency, contract link)
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted OK) and date range
- Completed SIG/CAIQ answers or an ETA for delivery
- KMS/residency matrix for any subprocessors who hold or handle encrypted key material

Can you confirm whether you can deliver an initial bundle and what the recommended cadence is for updates? If you can share a Drive link or zipped bundle that would be ideal.

Attachments requested: SOC 2 redacted PDF, SIG answers, subproc manifest, KMS matrix.

Best,
Amanda
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Labs
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda@acme-labs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provenance heatmap + evidence timetable for third-party roster

Amanda — thanks for the clear ask. I'm looping in Jonas (security evidence lead) and Irene (KMS/residency) to assemble the bundle. Proposed plan:

1) Today: share a live subprocessor manifest CSV and a short provenance heatmap explaining dependency tiers and data paths.
2) +48 hours: SOC 2 redacted PDF and SIG answers draft (we'll flag any questions we can't answer in the SIG spreadsheet).
3) +5 business days: full KMS residency matrix and final CAIQ/ SIG responses.

I can deliver the initial manifest now (attached) so you have something to start with; Jonas will follow up with SOC2 and SIG notes. Irene will confirm KMS residency timing. If Aug 10 is firm for the initial bundle we should be able to meet that with the draft SOC2 and manifest.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_manifest.csv (csv) — this is a live export of current active vendors and their roles.

Would you like status updates daily in this thread or a single consolidated drop?

—Jordan
Senior Manager, Third-Party Risk Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Amanda Torres <amanda@acme-labs.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provenance heatmap + evidence timetable for third-party roster

Amanda / Jordan — quick update from Security Evidence:

- SOC 2: we have a Soc 2 Type II report for the period 2024-12-01 to 2025-05-30. Full report is sensitive; attaching a redacted PDF with control test dates and auditor attestation.
- SIG/CAIQ: attached is our latest SIG responses workbook (v2). There are three open questions where we need vendor confirmation (marked in orange).
- KMS residency: Irene is pulling the authoritative matrix; expect that by end of day tomorrow. For clarity: Redwood does not share raw keys with subprocessors. Where subprocessors provide managed services (e.g., logging ingestion, hosted metrics) we record whether they have encrypted-at-rest access and whether key escrow or HSM custody is used.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-acme-evidence (I will drop the final artifacts here).

Attachments: soc2_type2_redacted_2025.pdf (pdf), sig_responses_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Let me know if you need a short call to walk through the orange cells; we can do a 20-min slot.

-Jonas

Redwood Inference
From: Amanda Torres <amanda@acme-labs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 12:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provenance heatmap + evidence timetable for third-party roster

Thanks Jonas — that's helpful. Two quick asks:
1) Can you flag which subprocessors in the CSV have access to production telemetry and whether that access is transient or persistent? (We need that column to populate our internal risk scoring.)
2) CAIQ prioritized: if you can push partial CAIQ answers for questions that are high-frequency (encryption, access control, logging) by EOD Aug 3 that would keep us on track for the Aug 18 close.

Also happy to take a 20-min walkthrough on Wednesday if that helps.

Best,
Amanda
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda@acme-labs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: provenance heatmap + evidence timetable for third-party roster

Amanda — thanks, we can do that. Final delivery plan:

- Today: live manifest (attached earlier) updated with new column "prod_telemetry_access" and notes (transient/persistent).
- Aug 1 (EOD): SOC2 redacted + SIG workbook with orange questions answered where possible.
- Aug 3 (EOD): prioritized CAIQ partials for encryption, access control, and logging.
- Aug 8: consolidated evidence bundle in Drive with final KMS residency matrix (kms_residency_matrix.pdf) and CAIQ complete answers.

Irene — assigning you the KMS residency matrix delivery (Aug 8 target). Jonas — please finalize the SIG workbook answers and flag anything that requires legal redlines.

I'll upload the consolidated bundle to the Drive folder and will post a single zip when complete. Also adding a DocuSign link if you need an updated data-processing addendum signed: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-ACME-ATTACH

Attachments included in final drop (anticipated): redwood_subprocessor_manifest.csv, soc2_type2_redacted_2025.pdf, sig_responses_v2.xlsx, kms_residency_matrix.pdf, caIQ_partial_responses.docx

If that timeline works, we'll keep status in this thread and set a 20-min walkthrough for Wednesday 10:00am PT unless you prefer a different slot.

—Jordan
